inspiration.observed_pattern: An UPDATE JOIN joins target rows to a grouped derived relation whose conditional positive and negative aggregates populate two target totals.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a media-feedback totals refresh. A grouped derived table sums positive and negative integer feedback separately with CASE, then an UPDATE JOIN changes only lesson items; an unrelated item and an item without matching feedback preserve their initial totals. The source schema, identifiers, labels, values, and application domain are not copied.

fixture_notes: Lesson 501 receives positive total 8 and negative total 2 from mixed feedback, lesson 502 receives only negative feedback, and lesson 503 has no matching lesson feedback. A trailer item with another kind verifies the UPDATE WHERE filter does not broaden the target set.
determinism_notes: All item and feedback identifiers, kinds, scores, aggregate expressions, and final primary-key ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE media_items (item_id INT PRIMARY KEY, item_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, positive_total INT NOT NULL, negative_total INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE media_feedback (feedback_id INT PRIMARY KEY, item_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, item_id INT NOT NULL, score INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: UPDATE media_items AS i INNER JOIN (SELECT f.item_kind, f.item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN f.score > 0 THEN f.score ELSE 0 END) AS positive_total, SUM(CASE WHEN f.score < 0 THEN -f.score ELSE 0 END) AS negative_total FROM media_feedback AS f GROUP BY f.item_kind, f.item_id) AS totals ON totals.item_kind = i.item_kind AND totals.item_id = i.item_id SET i.positive_total = totals.positive_total, i.negative_total = totals.negative_total WHERE i.item_kind = 'lesson'

checks.sql: SELECT item_id, item_kind, positive_total, negative_total FROM media_items ORDER BY item_id
